en.topic_title: Hong Kong’s mid-year birth rates fall below 30,000 for the first time despite HK$20k payouts for new parents
en.topic_summary:
Fewer than 30,000 babies were born over the past year, representing a plummeting birth rate despite the government’s monetary incentives aimed at encouraging fertility.



Lunchtime at a kindergarten. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



According to figures released by the Census and Statistics Department on Tuesday, a total of 29,709 babies were born from July 2025 to to the end of June this year.
